reason: T1 human sign-off — L1 architecture for reminders-instructions-enhancements. The design is a local-only instruction layer over the existing photo-aid seams: one text, image, or video instruction on routine reminders and app-created free-form events; video staged then committed under protected Application Support roots; fired-screen composition with an explicit Play control (no autoplay); injectable playback seam. 13 design decisions (D1–D13) are recorded; no owner decision remains open. Key risk surfaced for review: EventExtrasStore.setPhotoFilename currently replaces the extras row, which would erase a stored instruction — the design fixes it (C12) and pins it with tests.
